answer: Glacier melt-table bond: each identity locks 70 credits for one glacier stake. Each epoch it files one melt reading via a prism gauge, key-signed to the public table for raven auditors to recheck. A reading off by over 3%, a reused one, or a shared stake burns the bond. The k-th pays 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented gauges fail: serials are key-bound. An honest agent pays 40 once.
